en.headline: Man arrested after knife attack injures domestic helper and security guard at Baguio Villa
en.dek: A man in his twenties was detained after allegedly wounding two people with a knife outside the Pok Fu Lam estate on Monday morning.
body: Police arrested a man after a knife attack at Baguio Villa on Victoria Road, Pok Fu Lam, on Monday morning that left a domestic helper and a security guard injured.

Officers received multiple reports at about 9.20 am that a man was attacking people at the estate. A domestic helper sustained knife wounds to the neck and back; a male security guard suffered an elbow abrasion while intervening. Both were conscious and taken to Queen Mary Hospital. A 28-centimetre knife was recovered at the scene.

Police said the suspect, a resident of the estate believed to be in his twenties, was arrested on the spot. Officers later found an injured cat in his flat and handed it to the Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals for treatment. The case has been classified as wounding and is being handled by Western District Crime Squad. Motive is under investigation.

zh.headline: 碧瑤灣男子持刀傷人 外傭及保安受傷被捕
zh.dek: 周一早上薄扶林碧瑤灣發生持刀襲擊，一名外籍女傭及一名保安員受傷，警方當場拘捕涉案男子。
body: 周一早上約9時20分，警方接獲多人報案，指薄扶林域多利道550號碧瑤灣有人持刀傷人，一名外籍女傭及一名男保安員受傷。
女傭頸部及背部有刀傷，男保安員手肘擦傷，兩人清醒送往瑪麗醫院治理。現場撿獲一把約28厘米長的刀。警方當場拘捕涉案男子，他是該屋苑住客，年約20多歲。
其後警方在疑犯單位內發現一隻頭部受傷的貓隻，交由愛護動物協會帶走治理。案件列為傷人，由西區重案組跟進，動機仍在調查中。
